description: Configuring Salesforce opportunity management: sales stages, sales processes, opportunity record types, Path configuration, opportunity teams, opportunity splits, and forecasting categories. Use when setting up or restructuring the opportunity lifecycle for Sales Cloud. NOT for forecast types, rollup methods, quotas or manager adjustments — use admin/collaborative-forecasts. NOT for agreeing what the stages and exit criteria should be before any build — use admin/sales-process-mapping. NOT for CPQ pricing or product configuration. Keywords: BusinessProcess, sales process, OpportunityStage, ForecastCategoryName, PathAssistant, OpportunitySplit, OpportunitySplitType, OpportunityTeamMember, Opportunity.settings, enableOpportunityTeam, IsClosed, IsWon, IsPrivate.
inputs: List of sales stages needed per business motion (e.g., new logo vs. renewal)
Whether splits are required and which type (revenue vs. overlay)
Forecast types needed and whether Collaborative Forecasting is enabled
Existing record types and which sales process should apply to each
name: opportunity-management
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide: `OpportunitySettings` (`enableOpportunityTeam`, `enableOpportunityFieldHistoryTracking` default `true`, `doesEnforceStandardOpportunitySaveLogic` "can't be set to false", `enableOpportunityInsightsInMobile` deprecated at v59.0, `findSimilarOppFilter`, and the absence of any splits element — `references/metadata-examples.md` §1, §6) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_opportunitysettings.htm

Metadata API Developer Guide: `BusinessProcess` (the bare-vs-object-qualified `fullName` rule, `values` as `PicklistValue[]`, `isActive`, the wildcard-only-with-`RecordType` restriction, and the "don't use business processes as an access control mechanism" warning — `references/metadata-examples.md` §2, Gotcha 8) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_businessprocess.htm

Metadata API Developer Guide: `PathAssistant` and `PathAssistantStep` (one path per record type including `__Master__`; `entityName` / `fieldName` / `recordTypeName` not updateable; `picklistValueName` required; "a missing step … has not been configured"; deploy works with the preference off — `references/metadata-examples.md` §3, Gotcha 14) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_pathassistant.htm

Metadata API Developer Guide: `CustomValue` / `StandardValue` (the `ForecastCategories` enumeration `Omitted` / `Pipeline` / `BestCase` / `Forecast` / `Closed`, plus `won` and `probability` — Gotcha 13 and the checker's `VALID_METADATA_FORECAST_CATEGORIES`) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_customvalue.htm

Metadata API Developer Guide: `ForecastingType` (`opportunitySplitType` and `opptyLineItemSplitType` as the only split hooks in the whole Metadata API — `references/metadata-examples.md` §6) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_forecastingtype.htm

Metadata API Developer Guide: `Layout` / `RelatedListItem` (`relatedList` required, `fields` using retrieval aliases such as `Phone2` rather than API names — `references/metadata-examples.md` §4) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_layouts.htm
Metadata API Developer Guide (PDF, v62; all api_meta.txt line citations in this package resolve against it) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf

Object Reference: `Opportunity` (`StageName` cascading to `ForecastCategoryName` / `IsClosed` / `IsWon` / `Probability`; `IsClosed` and `IsWon` "directly controlled by `StageName`"; `Probability` and `ForecastCategoryName` overridable; `ExpectedRevenue` = Amount × Probability; `IsPrivate` removing teams, splits and sharing; `LastStageChangeDate` / `LastStageChangeInDays` — Core Concepts, Gotchas 9, 10, 12) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_opportunity.htm

Object Reference: `OpportunityStage` (read-only supported calls; `IsActive` values "retained for historical purposes only"; the six-value `ForecastCategoryName` list including `Most Likely` — Gotchas 1, 2, 8, 13; verification query 8a) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_opportunitystage.htm

Object Reference: `OpportunitySplit` and `OpportunitySplitType` (`SplitPercentage` 0–100 vs 0–1,000; `IsTotalValidated` create-only; no `create()` or `delete()` on the split type; the API owner-change note — Gotchas 11, 16; verification query 8d) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_opportunitysplit.htm

Object Reference: `OpportunityTeamMember` (`OpportunityAccessLevel` values `Read` / `Edit` / `All`; deleted members bypass the Recycle Bin and need `getDeleted()`; UI vs API ownership-change behaviour — Gotchas 15, 16; the Security pillar note above) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_opportunityteammember.htm

Object Reference: `OpportunityHistory` (records changes to Amount, Probability, Stage **or** Close Date only; returns nothing when none changed; auto-deleted with the parent — Gotcha 12; verification query 8c) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_opportunityhistory.htm

Object Reference: `OpportunityContactRole` (API applies opportunity access, not contact access; may return rows for inaccessible or deleted contacts — Gotcha 15) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_opportunitycontactrole.htm
Object Reference (PDF, v62; all object_reference.txt line citations in this package resolve against it) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf
outputs: Ordered configuration checklist for stages, sales processes, record types, and Path
Deployable BusinessProcess, RecordType, PathAssistant and Opportunity.settings XML
Decision guidance on whether to use revenue vs. overlay splits
Validation rules approach for enforcing stage progression
Forecast category mapping for each stage
